clips.title: The story
paras: Around Stonetalon Peak, faerie dragons yield scales coveted by Jin'Zil. The Darkspear witch doctor uses one as a reagent in a brew that mocks night elven nature magic.

Around Stonetalon Peak, faerie dragons haunt the wild groves of Kalimdor. Their scales gleam with natural magic. Night elves revere them as harmless woodland spirits and allies, while outsiders prize the scales as rare magical ingredients.
